I added a `DefaultBodyLimit` layer to the router in `rust/src/server/src/routes.rs`:

1. Imported `axum::extract::DefaultBodyLimit`.
2. Applied `.layer(DefaultBodyLimit::max(32 * 1024 * 1024))` in `build_router_with_options`, which is the shared function that `build_router` delegates to.

This overrides Axum's default ~2 MiB body limit with a 32 MiB limit across all routes, including `POST /v1/chat/completions`, so valid requests between 2 MiB and 32 MiB now return 200 OK instead of being rejected.
